lines: 他若求告我，我就应允他；
他在急难中，我要与他同在；
我要搭救他，使他尊贵。
他若求告我，我就應允他；
他在急難中，我要與他同在；
我要搭救他，使他尊貴。
He will call on me
and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him
and honor him.

He will call on me
and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him
and honor him.
When his cry comes up to me
I will give him an answer: I will be with him in trouble; I will make him free from danger and give him honour.

each of you not just looking to his own things

我将耶和华常摆在我面前，
因他在我右边，我便不至摇动。
我將耶和華常擺在我面前，
因他在我右邊，我便不至搖動。
I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand
I shall not be moved.

是未见之事的确据。

proof of things not seen.

神爱世人，甚至将他的独生子赐给他们，
叫一切信他的，不至灭亡，
反得永生。
神愛世人，甚至將他的獨生子賜給他們，
叫一切信他的，不至滅亡，
反得永生。
For God so loved the world
that he gave his one and only Son
that whoever believes in him should not perish
but have eternal life.

so that whoever has faith in him may not come to destruction but have eternal life.

他从祸坑里，从淤泥中，
把我拉上来，使我的脚立在磐石上，
使我脚步稳当。
他從禍坑裏，從淤泥中，
把我拉上來，使我的腳立在磐石上，
使我腳步穩當。
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit
out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock
and gave me a firm place to stand.

Above all these things

that he will also reap.

and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
